arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: Execution mode, 'plan' (run the execution plan from release.context_builder) or 'direct' (run the listed executions); case-insensitive.

arguments.name: sqlhome
arguments.description: Oracle home whose bin/sqlplus is used; sqlplus is taken from PATH when omitted.

arguments.name: on_error
arguments.description: What to do after a failed execution, 'abort' (skip the rest) or 'continue'; case-insensitive.

arguments.name: connection
arguments.description: Plan mode: common Oracle connection with IP, PORT and SID.

arguments.name: schemas
arguments.description: Plan mode: credentials per schema name, each an object (or a JSON string of one) with username and password.

arguments.name: execution
arguments.description: Plan mode: database context with execution_plan and scripts, normally the 'database' output of release.context_builder; SQLPlus is skipped when it has no execution_plan.

arguments.name: executions
arguments.description: Direct mode: executions to run, each an object with ip, port, sid, schema, username, password and script (SQL file path).

arguments.name: execution_path
arguments.description: Base directory for generated spool files (%execution_path); defaults to the first script's directory when spool is enabled.

arguments.name: release
arguments.description: Release name substituted for %release in spool file names.

arguments.name: spool
arguments.description: Spool management: enabled, create_if_not_exists, infile_replace, override, name_placeholder, wrappers_before and wrappers_after; disabled when omitted.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True when every execution succeeded and none was skipped.

outputs.name: skipped
outputs.description: Number of executions skipped after a failure with on_error 'abort'.

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Per-execution results: schema, script, success, exit_code, stdout summary, stderr, duration, spool, error_type and error_message.
